I usually just end up scrolling through my work emails or Instagram to try and distract myself from what I've done.\n\nDoctor: Do you ever have episodes of eating a large amount of food with a loss of control during the day as well, or is it only at night after work?\n\nPatient: No, it never happens during the day because I'm too busy and focused on my work. It strictly happens in the evening once I'm back in my apartment after a long, stressful day.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually wake up during the night to eat, or is the eating only happening after dinner while you are still awake?\n\nPatient: No, I don't wake up in the middle of the night to eat. It all happens while I'm still awake, starting as soon as I get home late from work and continuing while I'm on my laptop. I just end up staying up really late doing this before I finally go to bed.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually eat most of your food after dinner or at night, and do you ever wake up from sleep to eat? Or are these episodes more like sudden binges where you eat a very large amount in a short time while awake?\n\nPatient: No, I never wake up from sleep to eat; it always happens while I'm fully awake right after I get home. These are definitely sudden, out-of-control binges where I shovel down a massive amount of takeout food incredibly fast while sitting in front of my laptop.\n\nDoctor: Do you feel your eating is mainly concentrated in the evening and at night, with very little appetite or food intake earlier in the day? Also, has this pattern been going on for at least 3 months?\n\nPatient: Yes, it is definitely concentrated in the evenings, and this pattern has been going on for about three months now since my big work campaign started. I'm not really sure about my daytime appetite, but my main issue is definitely the out-of-control binging at night rather than how I eat during the day.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually eat very little in the morning and afternoon, with most of your food intake happening in the evening or at night? This helps me tell whether this is mainly a night-eating pattern or a binge-eating pattern.\n\nPatient: Honestly, I haven't paid close attention to my daytime eating habits, so I'm not entirely sure if I'm eating too little then. The main issue for me is the overwhelming loss of control and the massive amount of food I consume once I get home at night.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually eat very little or skip meals earlier in the day, with most of your food intake happening in the evening or at night?\n\nPatient: I don't think I necessarily skip meals or restrict myself during the day, as I usually eat normally when I have a moment at work. It's just that the out-of-control, binge-like eating consistently and specifically happens at night once I finally get home.\n\nDoctor: Do you ever find yourself eating after you have already gone to bed or waking up during the night to eat, or does all of the eating happen while you are still awake in the evening?\n\nPatient: No, I never wake up from sleep to eat, and I don't eat after I've already gone to bed. All of the eating happens while I'm still awake in the evening, usually right after I get home from work and while I'm sitting in front of my laptop.\n\nDoctor: When these episodes happen at night, do you feel a strong urge to eat after waking from sleep or after already falling asleep, or do they only happen while you are fully awake in the evening?\n\nPatient: They only happen while I am fully awake in the evening. I usually just end up scrolling through my work emails or Instagram to try and distract myself from what I've done.\n\nDoctor: Do you ever have episodes of eating a large amount of food with a loss of control during the day as well, or is it only at night after work?\n\nPatient: No, it never happens during the day because I'm too busy and focused on my work. It strictly happens in the evening once I'm back in my apartment after a long, stressful day.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually wake up during the night to eat, or is the eating only happening after dinner while you are still awake?\n\nPatient: No, I don't wake up in the middle of the night to eat. It all happens while I'm still awake, starting as soon as I get home late from work and continuing while I'm on my laptop. I just end up staying up really late doing this before I finally go to bed.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually eat most of your food after dinner or at night, and do you ever wake up from sleep to eat? Or are these episodes more like sudden binges where you eat a very large amount in a short time while awake?\n\nPatient: No, I never wake up from sleep to eat; it always happens while I'm fully awake right after I get home. These are definitely sudden, out-of-control binges where I shovel down a massive amount of takeout food incredibly fast while sitting in front of my laptop.\n\nDoctor: Do you feel your eating is mainly concentrated in the evening and at night, with very little appetite or food intake earlier in the day? Also, has this pattern been going on for at least 3 months?\n\nPatient: Yes, it is definitely concentrated in the evenings, and this pattern has been going on for about three months now since my big work campaign started. I'm not really sure about my daytime appetite, but my main issue is definitely the out-of-control binging at night rather than how I eat during the day.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually eat very little in the morning and afternoon, with most of your food intake happening in the evening or at night? This helps me tell whether this is mainly a night-eating pattern or a binge-eating pattern.\n\nPatient: Honestly, I haven't paid close attention to my daytime eating habits, so I'm not entirely sure if I'm eating too little then. The main issue for me is the overwhelming loss of control and the massive amount of food I consume once I get home at night.\n\nDoctor: Do you usually eat very little or skip meals earlier in the day, with most of your food intake happening in the evening or at night?\n\nPatient: I don't think I necessarily skip meals or restrict myself during the day, as I usually eat normally when I have a moment at work. It's just that the out-of-control, binge-like eating consistently and specifically happens at night once I finally get home.\n\nDoctor: Do you ever find yourself eating after you have already gone to bed or waking up during the night to eat, or does all of the eating happen while you are still awake in the evening?\n\nPatient: No, I never wake up from sleep to eat, and I don't eat after I've already gone to bed. All of the eating happens while I'm still awake in the evening, usually right after I get home from work and while I'm sitting in front of my laptop.\n\nDoctor: When these episodes happen at night, do you feel a strong urge to eat after waking from sleep or after already falling asleep, or do they only happen while you are fully awake in the evening?\n\nPatient: They only happen while I am fully awake in the evening. It always starts right after I get home from a long day at work while I'm sitting in front of my laptop, rather than waking up from sleep.\n\nDoctor: About how much of your total food intake do you think happens after dinner or in the evening, compared with earlier in the day?
